extDescription.message: A Chrome extension that spots likely AI-made shortform content and filters it locally.

popupTagline.message: Filters shortform posts that look like low-effort AI content.

popupEnabledHelp.message: When this is on, SlopSkip watches supported pages and filters posts automatically.

popupReelsAutoExpandCaptionHelp.message: Automatically opens each reel caption so SlopSkip can read more signals. Turn this off if you do not want the page UI touched.

popupDebugModeHelp.message: Shows score details and clues behind each decision. You can leave this off most of the time.

popupPauseOnManualRevisitHelp.message: If you scroll back or use an up key to revisit a post, SlopSkip will stop auto-filtering that post.

popupSensitivityHelp.message: Controls how easily a post gets filtered. Stronger settings may catch more false positives.

popupSensitivityConservativeHelp.message: Filters only when the signal looks clear.

popupSensitivityBalancedHelp.message: A safer default that catches a lot without being too jumpy.

popupSensitivityAggressiveHelp.message: Filters quickly when content looks suspicious. May catch more false positives.

popupMarkSlopHelp.message: Adds a local block so this creator gets filtered more aggressively.

popupMarkAllowHelp.message: Protects this creator from being filtered unless there is a very strong signal.

popupClearVoteHelp.message: Removes the local allow or block choice saved for this creator.

popupOpenOptionsHelp.message: Open the full settings page for thresholds, keywords, and local data.

popupStatusUnsupported.message: This page is not supported yet.

optionsSubtitle.message: Tune local filtering, manage custom phrases, and inspect the data saved in this browser.

optionsThresholdBody.message: Lower thresholds filter faster. Higher thresholds wait for clearer signals.

optionsThresholdTitleHelp.message: Lower numbers filter more easily. Higher numbers make filtering more cautious.

optionsThresholdOrderErrorLight.message: Light must stay higher than Medium so it remains the most cautious preset.

optionsThresholdOrderErrorStrong.message: Medium must stay higher than Strong so the strongest preset filters fastest.

optionsRulesTitleHelp.message: Add phrases you want SlopSkip to remember locally. Use one line per phrase.

optionsRulesBody.message: Enter one keyword or phrase per line. These stay in your browser only.

optionsRulesEnHelp.message: Phrases you often see in English captions or comments.

optionsRulesKoHelp.message: Phrases you often see in Korean captions or comments.

optionsRulesDefaultHelp.message: Phrases you want checked regardless of language.

optionsExportTitleHelp.message: Inspect, copy, import, or reset the settings and local decisions stored in this browser.

optionsExportButtonHelp.message: Displays the current SlopSkip data as JSON.

optionsCopyJsonHelp.message: Copies the visible local data snapshot to your clipboard.

optionsDownloadJsonHelp.message: Downloads a JSON backup of your local SlopSkip data.

optionsImportJsonHelp.message: Loads SlopSkip settings and local choices from a JSON backup.

optionsImportConfirm.message: Importing will replace the current local SlopSkip data. Continue?

optionsClearCreatorsHelp.message: Removes all saved creator allow and filter choices, but keeps thresholds and keywords.

optionsClearCreatorsConfirm.message: Clear all saved creator choices? Thresholds and keywords will stay.

optionsResetDataHelp.message: Restores SlopSkip local data to its default state in this browser.

optionsResetDataConfirm.message: Reset all local SlopSkip data in this browser?

optionsUndoHelp.message: Restores the local data snapshot from before the last data action.

optionsUndoImport.message: Imported data replaced your previous local state.

toastWouldSkip.message: Preview: this would be filtered because of $1. (score $2)

toastSkipTransitionUnconfirmed.message: A skip was requested, but the next post transition was not confirmed.

toastManualRevisitCountdown.message: You brought this post back. Skipping again in $1...
